meta.title: Appliance installation across Vietnam | Bluebolt Services
meta.description: Bluebolt Services runs appliance installation and warranty work for brands, marketplaces and retailers: intake, dispatch, sign-off and reconciliation.

hero.title: Vietnam's nationwide installation network for appliance brands
hero.lead: One dispatch partner for appliance installation and warranty work for brands, marketplaces and retail chains: order intake, technician dispatch, sign-off and reconciliation.

doors.title: Brands, technicians and customers on one network
doors.lead: Brands and marketplaces hand over orders, partner technicians take jobs through the app, and customers have one point of contact after installation.

brands.label: Brands & marketplaces
brands.title: Hand installation orders to one partner
brands.body: Bluebolt takes the order, dispatches a technician, records photo sign-off and reconciles with you job by job.

technicians.label: Technicians
technicians.title: Steady work in the area you know
technicians.body: The app suggests jobs by area, skills and availability. Sign-off and earnings for every job are right there in the app.

consumers.label: Customers
consumers.title: Had an installation and need help?
consumers.body: Call our hotline or register the warranty for a recent installation. We coordinate between you, the technician and the brand.

network.title: A technician network managed province by province
network.lead: We organise our network by province and region. Each job goes to the nearest technician with the right skills, and the map and province table follow our operating data.

trust.title: Operating figures
trust.lead: Every figure comes with a definition and an update date. If we cannot measure something yet, we do not show it.
trust.logosTitle: Brands and marketplaces we work with
trust.logosNote: Logos appear only with each partner's written consent.

challenge.title: Why is installation quality so hard for brands to control?
challenge.lead: Your products sell everywhere, but installation is usually split across many small crews, each with its own way of working.

pains.quality: Quality varies between provinces and between crews
pains.visibility: No view of where each job stands; missed appointments surface only when customers complain
pains.cost: Costs, paperwork and warranty claims are scattered and hard to reconcile

onePartner.title: One partner, one process
onePartner.body: You hand orders to Bluebolt. Every job follows the same five steps, from intake to reconciliation.

matching.title: Technicians matched by skill and location
matching.body: The system assigns each job to the nearest technician with the right skills for the appliance and an open slot.

photoProof.title: Photo sign-off and a clear status at every step
photoProof.body: Technicians record sign-off photos in the app. You see the status and photos of every job on your dashboard.

reconcile.title: Reconciliation job by job
reconcile.body: We reconcile with you on signed-off jobs only. Any extra materials are paid by the customer directly to the technician, using our published reference prices.

process.title: Every job follows the same five steps
process.lead: Step 00 is the customer's purchase from a brand or marketplace. From step 01, the job runs through Bluebolt's process until it is reconciled.
process.triggerLabel: the trigger, not counted as a step
process.pendingNote: The order of steps 02 and 03 and the intake channel in step 01 are awaiting the owner's confirmation (docs/03 section 14.1).

technology.title: A dashboard for brands, an app for technicians, one job record
technology.lead: The brand dashboard and the technician app share the same job record, so both sides always see the same status.
technology.caption: Illustrative UI
technology.captionNote: The data shown is an example, not a real job.

features.status: The status of every job, from intake to sign-off
features.photos: Sign-off photos attached to each job

features.jobs: Jobs suggested by area, skills and availability
features.signoff: Customers sign off directly in the app
features.earnings: Earnings tracked job by job, available any time

services.title: Installation and maintenance across four product groups
services.lead: Technicians are grouped by appliance type, so each job reaches someone with the right skills.

lap-dat-dieu-hoa.body: Wall-mounted and ceiling cassette units from any brand, installed and test-run before sign-off.

lap-dat-dien-may.body: Washing machines, fridges, dryers, water heaters, TVs, induction hobs, cooker hoods and water purifiers.

bao-tri-dinh-ky.body: Scheduled maintenance for store chains and offices that catches faults early and keeps equipment running.

lap-dat-robot-hut-bui.body: Setup, configuration and handover for robot vacuums and smart-home devices.

proof.title: Work we have delivered
proof.lead: Videos, case studies and partner logos appear only with the partner's written consent.
proof.videoNote: Awaiting written permission to use the video. Once approved, it will show as a cover image and load only when played.
proof.caseSlot: Case study: [Brand] rolled out in [N] provinces in [M] weeks
proof.caseNote: Needs one result metric, a quote from a real person and the brand's written consent.

standards.title: The standards we set for partner technicians
standards.lead: Four groups of standards we use to recruit, train and assess technicians.
standards.citationNote: The TCVN/QCVN references come from the old site and have not been verified.

qualification.title: Qualifications and experience
qualification.a: Vocational diploma or certificate in electrical, refrigeration or mechatronics work
qualification.b: Lead technicians: 1–2 years of hands-on installation
qualification.c: Electrical safety and work-at-height certificates preferred

skills.title: Technical skills
skills.a: Air conditioners: brazing copper pipe, pressure testing, vacuuming, charging refrigerant
skills.b: Washers and fridges: levelling, water connections, earthing
skills.c: TVs: wall drilling, bracket mounting, setup and network connection

conduct.title: Service conduct
conduct.a: Arrive at the time agreed with the customer
conduct.c: Clean up the work area and show customers how to use the appliance

safety.title: Safety and compliance
safety.a: Protective gear when working at height
safety.b: Check for electrical leakage before touching the unit
safety.c: Correct materials: copper pipe thickness, cable cross-section

knowledge.title: Installation guides and insights
knowledge.lead: Articles for after-sales managers, technical teams and customers.

cta.title: Ready to roll out installation for your brand?
cta.lead: Tell us your product categories, monthly volumes and the regions you need covered. We will send a quote and a proposed rollout plan.
cta.formPending: The quote form goes live once the lead-b2b contract is approved. Until then, both buttons lead to the Sales section of the Contact page.
